messages:
claire: Quick ask — support reports lots of "no project shown" tickets when calls are proxied. We need better console provenance without exploding metrics.
aj: Enforcement/billing has to remain authoritative (post-exchange). Observability can be sampled.
pat: Proposal: compact provenance tokens for sampled events. Store origin_key_id (clear) + eff_id_hash (HMAC prefix) + route metadata. No raw PII.
mike: Implementation: per-key reservoir sampler: keep first 8 events/day for low-volume keys, then 0.5% sample after. Also maintain a tiny LRU index of hot eff_hashes per key (size cap ~500).
claire: UX: show "sampled provenance examples" on the key page (eff_hash, route, reason). Add tooltip: "Samples shown are for debugging; billing uses authoritative counters."
aj: Add org-level opt-in toggle: "Include delegated identity details in UI (may increase storage)" default off. If enabled, show eff_hash list; else show anonymized counts only.
pat: Retention: 30 days default. Keys flagged for billing discrepancy get 90d. Need billing signoff for anything longer.
mike: Safety: assert sampled telemetry is read-only for quota math. Add CI test to fail if sampled pipeline referenced by enforcer.
ops-bot: deploy queued: provenance-sampler@staging -> v0.5.0 by ci/cd at 2026-03-23T16:02:01Z
claire: Action items: pat prototype sampler + eff_hash lib (PR by Thu), mike mock UI + tooltip copy, aj coordinate billing on retention & opt-in wording. Drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
